verdict.line: You lose if you let him land three hits and trade at length into his banked Indestructible shield; you win if you hit-and-run to deny that third proc and all-in the moment his W is down.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's kit is built for sustained exchanges: Passive (Darkness Rise) only turns on after he lands 3 hits or spells, and W (Indestructible) banks every point of damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume to heal. A long trade is a trade he wins by default. Garen's only route to the measured 48.5% win rate over 3,362 games is converting lane into short, decisive bursts instead of extended spin fights.

theirWindow.what: Once Darkness Rise procs he gets a damage aura and Move Speed on top of whatever shield he's banked in Indestructible. Disengage immediately rather than continuing to trade through it.

yourWindow.what: Indestructible is on an 8-12s cooldown depending on rank. The moment he uses it to consume his shield for healing, he has no banked damage to fall back on — commit Q's silence into E (Judgment) spin damage before he can rebuild it.

powerCurve.note: R online, passive sustain still wins trades
Stridebreaker and lower E/Q cooldowns close gap
R cooldown drops to 20s, repeat execute threat

start.why: The flat damage reduction on autos blunts Obliterate poke, and the extra sustain lets you outlast his Perseverance-vs-Indestructible healing race in the early trades.

boots.why: Extra attack speed means more autos land inside your Q (Decisive Strike) silence window before he can reposition to bank another shield tick.

core.why: The slow on proc keeps him from kiting out of E (Judgment) range after your all-in starts.
Attack speed scales your short-trade damage output instead of committing to a long spin war he's built to win.
Grievous Wounds directly cuts the healing he gets from consuming his Indestructible shield.

situational.when: if his indestructible shield is absorbing too much of your burst to get through
if obliterate and realm of death magic damage are deleting you too fast to trade
if you need faster rotations to punish his w cooldown window before he resets it

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force through repeated short trades converts to healing, which is how you keep pace with his passive-plus-shield sustain over a long lane.

summoners.why: Ignite denies the healing he'd otherwise get from consuming Indestructible's banked shield right as you commit the silence-into-spin all-in.

playing.title: Deny his third proc
playing.detail: Track autos and spells he's landed on you. Disengage before the third one triggers Darkness Rise's damage aura and Move Speed.

playing.title: Trade in bursts, not spin wars
playing.detail: Obliterate's bonus damage on a single target punishes standing in his 675-range poke. Hit and leave rather than holding position.

playing.title: All-in right after his W
playing.detail: The instant Indestructible is cast, his banked shield is spent. That's your window to commit Q's silence and E's spin damage before he rebuilds it.

playing.title: Save Judgment for committed trades
playing.detail: E (Judgment) drops to a 9s cooldown at rank 5 — don't burn it to poke; hold it for when he's already in range and can't disengage.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp range
playing.detail: His E pulls from 700 range, further than your E's 325. Don't walk up without minion wave between you.

playing.title: Don't waste early R
playing.detail: Demacian Justice is on a 140s cooldown at rank 1 — a missed execute attempt is a lane-defining mistake this early, so only commit it on a confirmed kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 48.5% head-to-head figure are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning on passive timing and shield windows is independent analysis of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Mordekaiser maintain his (P) by hitting and running often. Try to kill him when (W) is on cooldown.
